author: Russell Brand
description:
Chris opens up about how alcohol and other substances became a way of masking the drama and emotional issues in his life. But once he and Jackie got sober, there was nothing left to hide behind — and they had to start confronting the emotions, conflict, and relationship patterns underneath it all.

The conversation then turns to marriage, parenting, and learning to understand each other with more empathy. Jackie also reflects on how looking at her relationship with her father through a different lens helped her make sense of parts of her upbringing and heal some of that relationship.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Tommy Jackson reflects on becoming a millionaire by 30 — only to realize a few years later that having millions and being broke felt surprisingly similar. Despite the cars, houses, and money, he says he still lacked peace, joy, and purpose.

That realization pushed Tommy toward helping young people who came from difficult circumstances similar to his own. He argues that real change requires understanding where people are coming from rather than simply giving them more programs or handouts.
